prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1005; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head impact and post-injury symptoms consistent with concussion. Over the course of 11 visits, care focused on symptom monitoring, graded return to daily activities, vestibular and visual exercises, and headache management. The mechanism and force of the collision align well with the presenting injury. Treatment extended somewhat beyond the typical timeline for an uncomplicated concussion, largely because symptoms improved gradually rather than resolving on a fixed schedule. Several examination findings, including balance and oculomotor measures, support the diagnosis, while other neurological screening tests returned within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to the head or neck region, and no earlier treatment for that area is documented in the records available to this office. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service with no duplicate or repeated entries. Ongoing follow-up is planned to confirm continued recovery and to address any residual symptoms.
